# SYNCORA Tally on Mobile

> Syncora is an independent mobile and web dashboard for viewing synced Tally company data. Use Syncora Connector on the Windows PC running TallyPrime.

## Product
- View company vouchers, party ledgers, balances and reports on mobile or desktop browsers.
- Sign in, install the Windows connector on the computer running Tally, sync a company and select it in the dashboard.
- Tally and TallyPrime are trademarks of their respective owners. SYNCORA works alongside Tally and does not replace it.

## Public pages
- [Overview](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/): Features and connection steps.
- [Product overview](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/product-overview): What Syncora does, where it runs, and which TallyPrime data users can review.
- [Resources](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/resources): Setup guides and reviewed accounting workflows.
- [Pricing](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/pricing): Available plans and their terms.
- [TallyPrime setup](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/guides/tallyprime-setup): Windows connector setup and first sync.
- [Party ledgers on mobile](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/guides/tally-ledger-on-mobile): Find party transactions, filter by date and export a ledger PDF.
- [For accountants](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/for-accountants): Client review workflow and how to request a demo.
- [Sync troubleshooting](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/guides/tally-sync-troubleshooting): Check missing companies, stale figures and missing vouchers.
- [Support](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/support): Help with setup and account issues.
- [About](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/about): Information about the product.
- [Privacy](https://tallyonmob.vercel.app/privacy): Privacy information.
